fact: The LCA's 2010/11 annual report says the Universal Access Fund had entered its second year of operation and was expanding access to communications services in remote and rural areas; the law setting it up and amounts collected or paid are not in the captured text, and the year is the report's own, 2010/11.

Budget tables: the 11 digital line(s) held in both years total 1,003,814,035 LSL for 2026/27 against 725,488,825 for 2025/26, +38.4 per cent; 13 lines are held for 2026/27. Dated by the budget document.
